_note: NEW l10n keys for PA Secretary Mode · Call & email handling (#106) + Letters/notices/memos (#107), SPEC v2.1 §14, built to §21 ADVANCED. Format: key -> [bn, en]. Merge the `bn` value into app_bn.arb and the `en` value into app_en.arb (this project keeps @-metadata in app_en.arb only). After merging, add the parameterized keys listed in `_params` to the placeholders-metadata (merge_arb.py PARAMS) so gen-l10n emits the String Function(...) signatures, then run flutter gen-l10n. ZERO Bangla lives in any .dart file — every Bangla string is here. The reply templates and formal phrases are deterministic MOCKS; the UI always shows the honest paAiReviewMarker ('AI-generated — review') and never auto-sends. REUSED existing keys (NOT redefined here): save, cancel, delete, edit, retry, copy, share, copied, saved, saveFailed, deleteFailed, loadFailed.
